PART I THE GAZETTE OF PAKISTAN, EXTRA., SEPT. 26, 2025

ISLAMABAD, FRIDAY, SEPTEMBER 26, 2025

Acts, Ordinances, President’s Orders and Regulations

GOVERNMENT OF PAKISTAN

MINISTRY OF LAW AND JUSTICE

Islamabad, the 26th September, 2025

F. No. 2(1)/2025-Pub.—The following Ordinance promulaged on 25th September, 2025 by the President is hereby published for general information:—

ORDINANCE NO. IX OF 2025

AN

ORDINANCE

to amend and consolidate the laws relating to registration and training of nurses, nurse practitioners, midwives, midwifery associate and nurse auxiliaries

WHEREAS it is expedient to amend and consolidate the laws relating to registration, licensing and training of nurses, nurse practitioners, midwives, midwifery associate, nurse auxiliaries and to provide for matters connected herewith and ancillary thereto.

(727)

Price: Rs. 40.00

1985(2025)Ex.Gaz.

Sulaiman PC # 08 Job No. 1985 (25)Ex-Gaz-I Law and Justice
